name: @extas/studio
description: The social & content studio core (S23, PR 437–443; Blueprint C5): brand asset library, templates and rules, the video assembly engine, publishing adapters for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, the content calendar and approval queue, and comment/DM ingestion into the Support inbox. Every platform runs on its mock until the owner enters a real key; nothing publishes, schedules or spends without his OK.
